## C1 · Screen (every new source, cheap model)
Called once per source that was downloaded into the library. Reads the text from the library (no second download) and applies the Search Skill's definition of AI for Social Good, plus the domain module of the run. Records **passed** (waits for the in-depth analysis, *queued* on the audit page) or **filtered out**, with the reason, the relevance and the project the source is about (used to put new projects first).

### 🧑‍🔬 Skills in
`skills/search/SKILL.md`: definition of AI4SG.

`skills/domains/<domain>.md`: what counts in the run's domain.

-- the source, and the deployment the organiser (stage ②) or a reviewer placed it in, with its tool and its other sources
SELECT s.id, s.url, s.title, s.title_en, s.country, s.language, s.source_type, s.why_relevant, s.project_guess, s.domain, s.screen, s.text_chars,
       p.id AS placed_project_id, p.code AS placed_code, p.name AS placed_name, p.implementing_org AS placed_org, p.countries AS placed_countries,
       p.deployment AS placed_deployment, sp.method AS placed_by, sp.reason AS placed_reason, t.code AS tool_code, t.name AS tool_name,
       t.developer AS tool_developer,
       (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('sid', o.id, 'title', COALESCE(o.screen->>'headline_en', o.title_en, o.title),
                                                     'type', o.source_type) ORDER BY o.id), '[]'::jsonb)
        FROM source_projects osp JOIN sources o ON o.id = osp.source_id
        WHERE osp.project_id = p.id AND o.id <> s.id AND o.status <> 'duplicate') AS placed_others
FROM sources s
LEFT JOIN source_projects sp ON sp.source_id = s.id AND sp.method IN ('organised', 'manual', 'merged', 'duplicate')
LEFT JOIN ai_projects p ON p.id = sp.project_id
LEFT JOIN ai_tools t ON t.id = p.tool_id
WHERE s.id = $1

-- other sources already judged to be about an AI4SG project of the same name, and known projects of that name: a news story
-- about a project often does not describe the AI itself, which is established by the project's other sources
WITH me AS (SELECT id, lower(regexp_replace(COALESCE(project_guess, ''), '[^[:alnum:]]+', '', 'g')) AS k FROM sources WHERE id = $1),
near AS (
  SELECT 'source' AS kind, s.id, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.screen->>'headline_en', ''), s.title_en, s.title) AS headline, COALESCE(s.screen->>'reason', '') AS reason,
         lower(regexp_replace(COALESCE(NULLIF(s.screen->>'project_name', ''), s.project_guess, ''), '[^[:alnum:]]+', '', 'g')) AS k2
  FROM sources s, me WHERE s.id <> me.id AND s.screen->>'is_ai4sg' = 'true'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'project', p.id, p.code || ' · ' || p.name, COALESCE(p.synthesis->'llm'->>'summary', ''), lower(regexp_replace(a.n, '[^[:alnum:]]+', '', 'g'))
  FROM ai_projects p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT p.name AS n UNION SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(p.aliases)) a
)
SELECT DISTINCT ON (near.kind, near.id) near.kind, near.id, near.headline, left(near.reason, 300) AS reason
FROM near, me
WHERE length(me.k) >= 4 AND length(near.k2) >= 4
  AND (near.k2 = me.k OR (length(me.k) >= 6 AND length(near.k2) >= 6 AND (near.k2 LIKE me.k || '%' OR me.k LIKE near.k2 || '%')))
ORDER BY near.kind, near.id DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH s AS (
  UPDATE sources SET screen = $2::jsonb,
         screen_relevance = CASE WHEN $6::boolean THEN $3::real ELSE screen_relevance END,
         project_guess = COALESCE(NULLIF($4, ''), project_guess),
         domain_tags = CASE WHEN $6::boolean THEN $7::text[] ELSE domain_tags END,
         -- a source already analysed keeps its status (a re-screen only updates its tags); so does a duplicate that still passes
         status = CASE WHEN NOT $6::boolean OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM extractions e WHERE e.source_id = sources.id) THEN status
                       WHEN $5::boolean AND status = 'duplicate' THEN status
                       WHEN $5::boolean THEN 'passed' ELSE 'filtered_out' END
  WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id, status
), unplaced AS (   -- set aside on a re-screen: the organiser's placement is taken back
  DELETE FROM source_projects sp USING s WHERE sp.source_id = s.id AND s.status = 'filtered_out' AND sp.method IN ('organised', 'duplicate')
)
SELECT id AS source_id, status FROM s
